name: Tri-Colored Customers (scattered)
description: Tri-Colored Customers are 3-marble customers split into 3 color strips (one marble hole per color). Unlike the block version in the GDD, they are not joined into a 3x3 block: each one sits on its own in any lane, at any queue position, mixed with regular customers. At the front of its lane it takes one marble of each of its 3 colors, in any order, and completes when all 3 are in.
howToPlay: Tap boxes to send marbles to the conveyor. Striped customers need one marble of each of their 3 colors; they only take marbles when they reach the front of their lane, and a color they already have keeps riding the belt. Clear every customer to win. Level Editor: the 'Tri Sets' setting adds sets of 3 Tri-Colored Customers (each set uses 3 marbles of 3 different colors); every customer of a set is shuffled into a random lane and position.
author: Anastasiia Baeva

showcaseLevel.name: Tri-Colored Customers
showcaseLevel.desc: Striped customers are scattered among the regular ones: one marble of each color fills them
